craft_notes: Sthāyin: simultaneous dawn. Rows: longing then oneness. Rejected: smoothing obscure endings — killed: flagged, pair-sense secure. Read aloud: ache then arrival.

lines: Longing for the unparted station, make her — knowing — your own;
then the two-kind pair, settled and risen, dawn as one for bearer and borne.
l4.sanskrit_cite: anavacchinnapadepsus tāṃ saṃvidam ātmasātkuryāt śāntoditātmakadvayam atha yugapad udeti śaktiśaktimatoḥ
